# showcase-rounded/lib — SNAPSHOT copies (do not edit)

These `.mjs` are **byte-identical snapshots (2026-08-09)** of the design3d skill library
modules, copied so this standalone showcase is self-contained and re-renderable:

- `adaptive-segments.mjs`, `superquadric.mjs`, `rmf-frames.mjs`, `lathe-body.mjs`
  — from `~/.claude/skills/design3d/library/parts/`
- `procedural-pbr-canvas.mjs`, `round-edge-normal.mjs`
  — from `~/.claude/skills/design3d/library/materials-textures/`

**Edit the SKILL, never these.** To refresh, re-copy from the skill. This folder is a
demo / reference exemplar of how to compose the rounded-equipment toolkit — not a
source of truth. The skill remains the single source; these copies exist only so the
showcase renders without serving files from outside the project root.
